text: Dot Feeney is taken to the 9th over Fountain Ledge Nightstand Ban.

event: There is a funeral on Delmar. Most of the block goes. Some people who should be there are not.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: asks Gil about the title paperwork
thought: I need that deed before the funeral crowd arrives

speech.text: Can you confirm the lot’s clear title?

name: Kwame Bright
action: leans toward Dev, chuckles about the ban
thought: Everyone’s still whispering about that nightstand case

speech.text: You heard the mayor’s rant, huh? Still thinking it’ll stick?

name: Marta Doyle
thought: If I don’t find my brother’s name soon, I’ll lose hope

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: slides a file toward Dot, eyes narrowed
thought: Booker’s still out there, and I’m not letting her slip

speech.text: You know why I’m here, Dot—hand over the ledger

name: Maren Bello
thought: Maybe if I keep quiet, they’ll forget I’m watching

speech.text: Here, you’re good at this, right?

name: Milo Adeyemi
action: tugs Etta’s sleeve, points at TV
thought: Why does that man on screen look like dad?

speech.text: Why does he wear that hat?

name: Milo Adeyemi
action: stirs awake, watches the kids settle
thought: Sleep will end soon; I’ll have to count again

event: Notices go up on two doors in the Terraces. The letterhead is a company nobody has heard of.

name: Simone Adeyemi
thought: I hate seeing her blood, but it's my job

name: Rey Vasquez
thought: Can't let Nia hear that stupid song again

speech.text: Turn it off, you hear that?

name: Rufus Bello
thought: Oops, that's messy, hope Mom doesn't scream

name: Iris Amadi
thought: Rain feels endless, like the night shifts

speech.text: Looks like the sky's leaking again, doc

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: asks Rey about the new notices
thought: Those letters feel off, need to know why

speech.text: Dad, who put up those strange flyers?

name: Cassius Reyes
thought: He started it, now he gets wet

speech.text: Your turn, Elias!

name: Kwame Nakamura
thought: Enough noise, I just want the silence

name: Simone Adeyemi
title: Public Haircut Ban
text: Simone Adeyemi is taken to the 9th over Public Haircut Ban.

event: An ambulance takes someone out of the Terraces before dawn. Nobody says a name.

text: Day 747: the city took $1,786 and spent $720. Treasury $261,579.

event: built
name: Halloway Cottages
text: Halloway Cottages opens on what was empty ground in The Terraces.

name: Errol Brannon
thought: Numbers blur, but the brother’s face stays sharp

speech.text: Did you notice any extra cash in the register?

name: Farrah Osei
action: shifts a crate slower than usual
thought: Every crate feels heavier than my hopes

speech.text: You think the manager will notice the broken pallet?

name: Booker Lyle
action: signs the delivery slip without looking up
thought: Another shipment, another lever to pull later

speech.text: Make sure the cash matches the invoice, Wes.

name: Fr. Emmanuel Boateng
action: places a hand on the desk, smoothing the wood
thought: Prayers for the young men echo in these walls

speech.text: May we find peace before the next funeral, Adaeze.

name: June Lindqvist
action: counts the float, rubbing the cold metal
thought: If I stay quiet, they’ll leave me alone

speech.text: Did the market get any new deliveries today?

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: flips a page in the file, eyes narrowing
thought: Lyle’s ledger hides more than numbers

speech.text: Simone, keep an eye on his cash flow tonight.

name: Nia Nakamura
action: adjusts the machine’s settings, humming low
thought: Power feels like a distant promise

speech.text: Hector, the belt’s jammed again—can you fix it?

title: Fountain Ledge Nightstand Ban
text: Errol Brannon is taken to the 9th over Fountain Ledge Nightstand Ban.
